outcome: Extent of nHFOV use in Romanian Level III NICUs
Types of noninvasive respiratory support modes used
cohort: Leaders from 21 Level III Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICUs) in Romania, regarding their practices for term and preterm infants with respiratory distress.
finding: nHFOV is used in over half of Romanian Level III NICUs to support term and preterm infants with respiratory distress, despite a lack of consensus on indications and settings.
cross-section timing: Data was collected via a web-based questionnaire in a recent survey.
